metadata.title: Connector and industrial component sourcing
metadata.description: Ask about a hard-to-find part, an alternative component or a larger quantity. See which details to send to Teknomont and attach your documentation.

hero.title: Looking for a specific
hero.description: Send the manufacturer part number, required quantity and delivery date. We will check sourcing options for your harness or equipment component and, if alternatives are acceptable, consider other options as well.
hero.note: You can attach a photo, datasheet or parts list. If the part number is unknown, describe the markings and application.

useCases.title: What can your inquiry
useCases.description: A clear description of the component and order requirements helps us check the available options.

availability.title: A specific part is unavailable
availability.description: The part is not in the store, or you are looking for another supply option. Start with the complete manufacturer designation, including its suffix.
availability.include: manufacturer, part number, quantity and required delivery date.

alternative.title: An alternative is acceptable
alternative.description: You can consider another manufacturer or series. Specify which parameters and construction details must remain the same.
alternative.include: original part number, documentation and compatibility requirements.

series.title: You need a larger quantity
series.description: You want a quotation for a larger order or expect to reorder the same component. Describe the anticipated demand.
series.include: quantity per delivery and whether this is a one-off or recurring purchase.

process.title: From your inquiry
process.description: Availability differs by part number. Price, quantity and delivery time are established for each inquiry.

request.title: Describe your requirements
request.description: Send the part designation, quantity and requirements. A photo, drawing or datasheet helps establish what you need.

search.title: We check the options
search.description: We check availability and possible sources for the specified component. If alternatives are acceptable, we include this in the search.

agreement.title: Agree on the details
agreement.description: Before ordering, we agree on the specific item, quantity, price and delivery time. Mention any need for a sample or additional documentation in your inquiry.

delivery.title: Fulfil the agreed order
delivery.description: After the terms are accepted, we fulfil the order as agreed. For recurring demand, we can discuss arrangements for subsequent deliveries.

preparation.title: An exact part number or an acceptable replacement?
preparation.description: Let us know whether you need a particular manufacturer's part or can consider an alternative. For connectors, the mating part designation, photographs of both sides and dimensions are also useful.
preparation.approval: Before accepting an alternative, compare its documentation with your application requirements. If you need a sample to check fit, include that in your inquiry.

connection.title: Connection and mounting
connection.description: Contact count and arrangement, pitch, dimensions, mounting and wire termination method.

electrical.title: Electrical parameters
electrical.description: Required voltage, current and connected wire cross-section.

documents.title: Documentation and project requirements
documents.description: Datasheet, drawing and any standards or requirements the component must meet.

faq.title: Before sending an inquiry
faq.description: A few practical points to help you prepare a quotation request.

identification.question: What should I send if I do not know the part number?
identification.answer: Attach clear photos of the markings and the complete component. Include dimensions, connection method and application. For a connector, show the contact side and its mating part. These details help with identification; explain any missing information in your message.

list.question: Can I send a list of several part numbers?
list.answer: Yes. Attach the list in a single XLS, XLSX or PDF file and describe your requirements in the form. Include manufacturer, part number and quantity for each line. The maximum attachment size is 3.5 MB.

terms.question: How are price, lead time and minimum quantity established?
terms.answer: Terms depend on the specific part number, quantity and supply options. State your required date and quantity, and include the frequency if you expect regular purchases. These details form the basis of an individual quotation.

sample.question: How do I request a sample or documentation?
sample.answer: Mention it in the additional information field along with the parameters you need to check. Sample availability and documentation need to be established for the specific component.

inquiry.title: Send a part number
inquiry.description: Describe what you need. If you do not know the part number, enter a short description in the first field and add details and a photo to your message.

items.part: Full part number and manufacturer, or a description with the component markings.
items.quantity: Quantity, required delivery date and any recurring delivery needs.
items.requirements: Whether you accept an alternative or need a sample or specific documentation.

inquiry.attachmentNote: Attach one file up to 3.5 MB: a photo, technical document or parts list. You do not need every specification to start — send the information you have.

metadata.title: Connectors, cables and wire harness materials
metadata.description: TE Connectivity connectors, LAPP cables, braided sleeves and industrial components. Explore catalogue examples, visit the store or request a quotation.

hero.title: Connectors, cables
hero.description: Housings, contacts, cables and protective materials for electrical connections, alongside components for industrial equipment. Explore the range, compare specific part numbers in the store or send an inquiry for the quantity you need.
hero.note: Already have a part number? Include the manufacturer and required quantity in your inquiry to help identify the right item.

categories.title: From electrical connections
categories.description: Choose a group to go directly to the store catalogue. For an inquiry, include the manufacturer part number and the parameters that matter for your application.

connectors.title: Connectors, housings and contacts
connectors.description: Plugs, sockets, housings and contacts for wire-to-wire, wire-to-board and panel-mounted connections. The catalogue also includes accessories for connector systems.
connectors.examples: TE Connectivity CPC, MQS and Junior Power Timer, IDC connectors and HARTING components.
connectors.selection: Series and full part number, contact count, pitch, mounting method and whether you need a housing alone or contacts as well.

wires.title: Wires and cables
wires.description: Cables for harnesses, data transmission and equipment connections. Individual items differ in conductor count, cross-section, insulation and shielding.
wires.examples: LAPP UNITRONIC, HELUKABEL cables and MANEX cables including FLRYY and RKKB.
wires.selection: Cable designation, conductor count and cross-section, shielding, required voltage, operating conditions and length.

protection.title: Harness protection and routing
protection.description: Braided sleeves, tubing, cable glands and grommets for protecting cables and routing them through housings. Selection depends on harness dimensions and the installation.
protection.examples: HellermannTyton 170-12000 PET sleeving and items in the sleeves, tubing, cable glands and grommets categories.
protection.selection: Harness or cable diameter, opening dimensions, thread type, material and environmental requirements.

controls.title: Equipment and automation components
controls.description: Relays, sensors, switches and selected electronic components. The store also has separate categories for semiconductors, resistors and capacitors.
controls.examples: Relays and accessories, inductive sensors, switches and circuit switches.
controls.selection: Full manufacturer designation, electrical parameters, connection method, dimensions and required quantity.

examples.title: Specific part numbers
examples.description: Three examples from different parts of the range: a panel connector, a data cable and harness protection.
examples.note: Check the product page in the store for current price, availability and the full description.

connector.title: CPC panel housing, 19 positions
connector.description: Connector housing for panel mounting. The catalogue item is supplied without contacts; include them when specifying a complete connection.

cable.title: UNITRONIC LiYY A, 5 × AWG22
cable.description: Data cable with PVC insulation. Catalogue specifications include a 300 V rated voltage and 5.9 mm outer diameter.

braid.title: PET braided sleeve, 14–26 mm
braid.description: Black HF sleeving for routing and protecting cables. Catalogue specifications include a −50 to +150°C temperature range and UL94 V-2 flammability rating.

shop.title: Order through the store
shop.description: Check the part number, description, sales unit and current availability on the product page. Compare the designation with the documentation for your equipment or harness before ordering.

inquiry.title: Quote for a part number or larger quantity
inquiry.description: If the required item or quantity is not in the catalogue, send an inquiry. Useful details include:

items.part: Manufacturer and full part number, or a photo or documentation if the number is unknown.

items.requirements: Required delivery date and whether an alternative product is acceptable.

metadata.title: 3D IDC ribbon cable configurator
metadata.description: Select conductor count, length and terminations for your IDC ribbon cable. Rotate the 3D model, download the specification and request a quotation.

IdcStudio.title: Your connection.
IdcStudio.description: Choose cable parameters and terminations. Explore the connection in 3D, then send us the specification for a quotation.
IdcStudio.quoteNote: We will confirm pricing, lead time and feasibility after reviewing your inquiry.
IdcStudio.previewNote: Illustrative model. Housings and connector orientation show the configuration; they are not manufacturing documentation or confirmation of the pinout.
IdcStudio.otherNeeds: Need a different cable, pitch or specific part number?

fields.lengthHelp: L is measured between connector axes, or to the cable end if no connector is selected. We will confirm the reference in the quotation.
fields.customHelp: The translucent shape represents a custom connector. It does not reproduce the specified part.
fields.same: Same side — sockets facing the same way
fields.byDrawing: To be agreed from the drawing
fields.orientationHelp: Housing orientation does not define electrical connections. We will agree the pinout from your documentation.

viewer.title: 3D preview
viewer.canvas: 3D IDC cable model: {pins} conductors, length L {length} mm. Use the buttons below to control the view.
viewer.help: Drag: rotate · wheel / pinch: zoom · right button / two fingers: pan. You can also use the buttons.
viewer.error: 3D preview is unavailable in this browser. You can still configure the cable and send an inquiry.
viewer.lost: The browser interrupted the 3D preview. Your configuration parameters are preserved.

form.title: Configuration ready? Request a quotation.
form.description: Enter your contact details. We will include all configurator parameters in the inquiry, including custom part numbers.
form.includedDescription: IDC · {pins} conductors · L {length} mm. See the summary above for the current parameters.
form.confirmation: We will agree actual parts, dimensions, tolerances and electrical connections before production. The 28 AWG / PVC cable is an inquiry option, not confirmation of availability.
form.name: Full name

form.fileHelp: One file, max. 3.5 MB. Include pinout documentation if a specific contact arrangement is required.

form.invalidConfig: Check the length, quantity and part numbers for both terminations.

form.error: The inquiry could not be sent. Please try again or reach us through the Contact page.
